releases.summary: Prepared the next feature release with improved maintainability and container publishing.

changes.description: Started the 1.1.0 release cycle and synchronized the project version across release metadata.

releases.summary: Added the Advin Convoy VPS API foundation.

changes.description: Added /servers to list authenticated Advin VPS servers through the Convoy API.
Added a grouped Advin Convoy API reference covering authentication, permissions, route families, and safety guidance.
Guarded unsharded Discord client cleanup so early startup failures cannot trigger a secondary 'Shard 0 not found' rejection.
Added an authenticated ConvoyClient for Advin VPS customer API requests, including JSON and PNG responses.
Added optional ADVIN_API_URL and ADVIN_API_KEY configuration and exposed the client on the bot application.

releases.summary: Improved account-linking feedback and command UI consistency.

changes.description: The Link Account button now checks the Discord Adapter first and clearly reports when the user is already linked.
Already-linked users receive a direct Unlink Account action before starting a new link request.
Corrected shared-helper imports in the link button so the bot starts cleanly after deployment.
Successful player verification now grants the configured linked-player role and sets the Discord nickname to the Dune character name.
Added a repository-wide Prettier configuration with format and format:check scripts for consistent source formatting.
GitHub Actions now checks the entire repository with Prettier on every push and pull request.
Added ESLint unused-variable checks so stale const declarations and imports fail CI.
Changed formatting and lint scripts to automatically remove fixable unused declarations and imports while applying Prettier consistently.
Added focused inline documentation around shared UI factories, API transport, loaders, and application lifecycle ownership.
Added safe link-response diagnostics showing character, status, message, and response fields without logging verification codes.
Added ESLint JSDoc guidance for public functions, classes, and methods so new exported APIs receive consistent documentation.
Migrated ESLint configuration to eslint.config.js flat config format for ESLint 10 compatibility.
Removed all empty JSDoc placeholders and stopped automated tooling from generating blank documentation blocks.
Added meaningful JSDoc to shared component/image factories, environment loading, and Convoy API transport methods.
Expanded JSDoc coverage across the Dune API facade, blueprint validator, and recursive module discovery utility.
Removed JSDoc blocks and the JSDoc lint dependency for now, leaving the source tree with concise regular comments only.
Added protected /reload commands, components, and all targets using role 1539721769244565566 for live module refreshes.
Aligned src with the documented Discord bot layout by moving shared UI factories into shared/factories and adding dedicated menus and constants folders.
Added .gitkeep markers to empty menus and shared constants directories so planned extension points remain tracked.
Added Dependabot updates for npm dependencies, GitHub Actions, and Docker base images with grouped pull requests.
Release automation now publishes versioned and latest Docker images to GitHub Container Registry using GitHub Packages.
Cleaned up .env.example into grouped Discord, Console, channel, and diagnostics sections and removed the legacy panel-channel fallback.
Slash commands now use the shared Components V2 response and Dune banner factories.

releases.summary: Improved panel discovery when multiple bot branches share a channel.

changes.description: Expanded /profile with readable currency, Solaris Coin, factions, intel, specs, progression, and vitals data.
Added guild lookup to /profile and display of the linked character's guild name when available.
Added guild-member lookups and full debug responses to reliably identify a player's guild membership.
Removed the character-name filter from guild discovery, matched members by player ID, and corrected the guild_name field shown in /profile.
Enabled safe full debug logging across interactions, Console API requests, and Discord Adapter requests without logging credentials or file contents.
Console API requests now automatically re-authenticate once and retry when the session expires or is lost during bot operation.
Added process-level rejection and exception logging plus timeout-aware network errors for Console API and Discord Adapter requests.
Added Discord gateway reconnect, resume, disconnect, and invalid-session diagnostics plus retries for temporary Console API failures.
Removed the unsupported player stats request and made /profile responses visible in the channel instead of ephemeral.
Cleaned up /profile output by hiding Pawn ID, rounding vitals, and adding a feature flag for future Smuggler faction data.
Added /profile to show the invoking user's linked character through the Discord Adapter actor context; /players remains the server-wide player list.
Panels now find and update their own message by title instead of relying on the latest bot message.
Player-link and blueprint panels can now coexist safely in the same Discord channel.
Added shared Components V2 and Canvas banner factories to reduce duplicated UI construction across commands and panels.
Migrated all slash-command responses to the shared Components V2 response helper and routed command artwork through the centralized Dune banner generator.
Replaced the outdated README with a simpler setup, Docker, release, configuration, and documentation guide.

releases.summary: Fixed the Docker build and GitHub Actions runtime configuration.

changes.description: Corrected the Alpine emoji font package name so Docker images build successfully.
Updated CI and release workflows to use Node.js 24 and removed the Node.js 20 deprecation warning.

releases.summary: Fixed missing fonts in Canvas-generated Discord images.

changes.description: Added fontconfig, DejaVu fonts, and Noto emoji fonts to the Docker image so generated images render Unicode characters and emoji instead of square glyphs.

releases.summary: Removed server-specific Crimson Skies branding from generated command artwork.

changes.description: Replaced hardcoded server branding and asset names with generic Dune Server placeholders.
Clarified that deployment-specific channel IDs belong only in environment configuration.

releases.summary: Organized the source tree and improved blueprint audit logging.

changes.description: Grouped Discord-facing code, infrastructure, reusable modules, and shared helpers into clear source areas.
Blueprint imports now resolve the Console player correctly and use the player pawn ID.
Blueprint audit messages include the uploaded JSON through a Components V2 File component.
Updated project and source-layout documentation.
